apps.localizedDescription: Manage tasks and recurring routines that reset reliably by calendar day, build a daily streak without freezes, use Guided Access, verify tasks with AI photos, and customize the language, color scheme, and app icon. Available in English and German. AI-generated app and pictures.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds an opt-in autonomous single-app mode powered by iOS Guided Access. When enabled, starting a task requests strict lock mode and completion releases it after photo verification.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera takes a completion photo for AI verification of the task.

news.title: Discipline 1.0.4: Autonomous Single-App Mode
